name: subjective-devagents
description: Dark desktop IRC + LLM agents IDE for #subjective (My Agents / DevAgents).

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/preload.js && node --check src/messageRenderer.js && node --check src/renderer.js && node --check src/taggyClient.js && node --check src/mobile-bridge.js && node --check src/llmService.js && node --check src/systemUsers.js && node --check src/suSessionManager.js && node --check src/terminalWindow.js && node --check src/terminalPreload.js && node --check src/chatCore.js && node --check src/webServer.js && node --check web/webBridge.js && node --check web/terminalWebBridge.js
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*_test.py'
scripts.vendor:xterm: mkdir -p assets/vendor && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/lib/xterm.js assets/vendor/xterm.js && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css assets/vendor/xterm.css && cp node_modules/@xterm/addon-fit/lib/addon-fit.js assets/vendor/xterm-addon-fit.js && cp node_modules/@xterm/xterm/LICENSE assets/vendor/xterm.LICENSE
scripts.mobile:prepare: mkdir -p mobile-www/assets && cp mobile/index.html mobile-www/index.html && cp src/styles.css src/messageRenderer.js src/renderer.js src/taggyClient.js src/mobile-bridge.js mobile-www/ && cp -R assets/. mobile-www/assets/
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:apk: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && GRADLE_USER_HOME=../.gradle ./gradlew assembleDebug
